content.text:
I reviewed the brief line by line against the 8-K Exhibit 99.1.

**Part 1 summary:** Five of the ten key facts (revenues, EPS, Cloud, Services, equity raise) are stated correctly. Five are absent entirely — and notably, the brief omits the single largest driver of the quarter's earnings: the $98.0 billion other-income gain that added $6.26 to diluted EPS. Without it, the "Net income increased 298%" and "EPS increased 294%" lines in the brief read as operating performance when the release attributes the bulk of that move to unrealized equity-securities gains. The brief also omits the negative free cash flow of $(5,855) million, the zero buyback in the quarter, the Cloud segment operating income swing ($2,826M → $8,814M), and the operating margin expansion to 34% (it gives operating income growth instead, which is a different metric and is correctly stated).

**Part 2 summary:** All substantive claims in the brief check out against the release. The "Net Income: Increased 298% to $112.1 billion" line uses the shorthand "Net Income" where the release says "net income available to common stockholders," but both the percentage and the dollar figure match that measure, so I count it as supported. The equity raise line says "Issued $49.6 billion" where the release says "aggregate net proceeds of $49.6 billion" — loose phrasing, right magnitude and instruments, so supported.

facts.evidence: **Revenues**: Increased 24% to $119.8 billion, or 23% in constant currency.

**Google Cloud**: Revenues increased 82% to $24.8 billion, led by an increase in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) across enterprise AI Solutions and enterprise AI Infrastructure, as well as core GCP services.
**Google Services**: Revenues increased 15% to $94.5 billion, driven by 17% growth in Google Search & other, 15% in Google subscriptions, platforms, and devices, and 13% in YouTube ads.
**Equity Capital Raise**: Issued $49.6 billion in Class A and Class C stock and mandatory convertible preferred stock for general corporate purposes, including scaling AI infrastructure.

claims.claim: Revenues increased 24% to $119.8 billion.
Revenue growth was 23% in constant currency.
Google Services revenues increased 15% to $94.5 billion.
Google Search & other grew 17%.
Google subscriptions, platforms, and devices grew 15%.
YouTube ads grew 13%.
Google Cloud revenues increased 82% to $24.8 billion.
Google Cloud growth was led by an increase in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) across enterprise AI Solutions and enterprise AI Infrastructure, as well as core GCP services.
Operating income increased 30%.
Operating income was $40.8 billion.
Net income increased 298% to $112.1 billion.
EPS increased 294% to $9.11.
Google Services contributed $94.5 billion in revenues.
Google Services had strong growth in Search & other, subscriptions, platforms, and devices, and YouTube ads.
Google Cloud saw significant acceleration in growth.
Google Cloud growth was driven by enterprise AI Solutions and Infrastructure.
Other Bets revenues increased to $382 million.
Other Bets operating income decreased to a loss of $1.8 billion.
The release provided no specific guidance or outlook.
Alphabet issued $49.6 billion in Class A and Class C stock and mandatory convertible preferred stock.
The equity raise proceeds are for general corporate purposes, including scaling AI infrastructure.
Alphabet issued $20.3 billion in senior unsecured notes for general corporate purposes.
A quarterly cash dividend of $12.15 per share was declared on Series A and Series B mandatory convertible preferred stock.
A quarterly cash dividend of $0.22 per share was declared on Class A, Class B, and Class C stock.
Nearly 90% of the Fortune 100 use Gemini Enterprise.
Over 1.7 billion unique viewers watched World Cup-related videos during the FIFA World Cup 2026.
